description: For a fixed inclusive-bound matrix \(D(\vec x,\vec y)\), PA proves that \(D(\vec x,\vec y)\) implies acceptance of the specified builder for the closed sentence obtained from \(\exists\vec y\,D(\vec x,\vec y)\) by substituting numerals only for \(\vec x\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.existential_append_internal {r k : ℕ}
  (D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin r ⊕ Fin k))
  (hD : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.DeltaZero D) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.close
      ((FirstOrder.Language.Formula.relabel (⇑finSumFinEquiv) D).imp
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.builderAccepted
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.proofFormula
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.construction.existentialBuilder D hD)
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.construction.existentialCode D))))
